component.name: Loböle
component.summary: Parametric B-Rep CAD for parts, assemblies, drawings, and simulation

description.p: Loböle is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built around a deterministic, scriptable document model. Create constrained sketches, solid features, assemblies, drawings, configurations, and FEM studies.
Projects use a diffable format with checkpoints and Git-backed history, while the same command layer is available to the GUI, Python, and MCP automation clients.
Simulation past linear static: buckling, thermal, large deformation, contact and plasticity. Scans and meshes you can work with as they are.

ul.li: Buckling studies: the load factor at which a part loses stability, and its shape, with one governing factor that also accounts for yield, layer strength and how sensitive a curved wall is to imperfections
Thermal studies: a part's temperature from fixed temperatures, heat flows and convection, and the stress a temperature change causes in a part or across an assembly
Studies can be solved on CalculiX, which the Linux AppImage and the Flatpak now include. On Windows, install it and point Preferences, Simulation at it
Large deformation and snap-through: an arch or a curved wall pressed across its curve reports the load it snaps at, which a linear study cannot see
Contact: a part resting on the ground or on another part, with friction, reports the contact area, force and pressure
Plasticity: steel yields and hardens, a part reports its plastic strain and the shape it keeps after unloading, and an overload reports its collapse load

Static studies refine the mesh around the highest stress until it settles, and say whether it did. A stress peak right at a support's edge, which grows as the mesh gets finer, is flagged and read a short distance away instead
Pin supports that only push where the part presses on the pin, with each support's reaction moment

Every material's numbers are cited to their source, with conductivity, expansion and a service temperature. Stainless 1.4301 and a thermostatic bimetal strip are new, and brass loses its uncited yield strength. Generic aluminium is gone, because its strength and conductivity depend on the alloy: a project naming it is refused on open, naming 6061-T6 and 6082-T6 to choose from
Meshes can be kept as meshes: an STL, OBJ, PLY or glTF imports as a mesh body you can measure, section, check for printing and export. Auto chooses between that and rebuilding the true faces
Imported STLs of mechanical parts are recognised: holes, flats, cones and spheres become true faces, so a hole has a diameter and an axis, and mates on them survive a reimport
Scans can be placed: an import takes a position, rotation and scale, and the Align tool sets a scan on its floor and centres it

Fit a plane, cylinder, cone or sphere to a scan where you click, robust to noise and lumps. A datum plane or axis made from a fit refits when the scan is replaced, and parts can be mated to it and sketches drawn on it
The Cradle tool cuts a holder shaped to a scan, and booleans take a mesh as the tool
A section of a body can become a sketch, refitted every time the model rebuilds
Every import runs in the background with progress and cancel, and heavy features build without freezing the window, with one cancel rule for all of them

Disc cams: a CamProfile feature cuts a cam from a follower's motion, a contact relation drives the follower from the cam's shape, and a check reports whether the follower stays on its cam and the forces involved
Drawings can show an assembly's exploded view, and the bill of materials gives printed parts their printed weight
Projects are saved as .lob. Older .dsgn projects open and save as the .lob beside them
The MCP workflow asks an agent to run static and buckling studies on any part that carries a load before calling it done
Fixed: steel's stiffness is 210 GPa, as Eurocode 3 gives it, instead of 200 GPa. Steel parts deflect about 5 % less than before
Fixed: a slow-converging solve is no longer reported as an unconstrained model, and a model that really is unconstrained names the motion it is free in
Fixed: a study run directly uses the GPU solver as a background run does, and a GPU failure is reported instead of hidden
Fixed: a load set by a variable shows its value in the panel and on the label, instead of 0 N
Fixed: a part held by contact alone is no longer refused because the contact's stabilising springs were too stiff for it
Fixed: refining a face no longer produces false stress peaks or fails at fine sizes
Fixed: an ASCII STL or OBJ written with whole-number coordinates is read at its real precision, so it is recognised and rebuilt correctly
Fixed: the bounding box in the project state is the measured one, instead of a box several times a curved part's size
Fixed: the print check measures a long bridge on an imported STL as one span, instead of passing it triangle by triangle
Fixed: a measured box hugs a part cut by a sphere
Fixed: a small sphere cut beside a fillet on a revolved part no longer leaves a stray face
Fixed: Check geometry reports open edges, and no longer counts the seam where two tangent cylinders are joined as one
Fixed: an edge between two named faces keeps the same name from one rebuild to the next, so a fillet on it does not move
Fixed: an extrusion of a single closed spline has the right volume
Fixed: Python type checkers before mypy 2.1 accept a CamProfile spec
Fixed: an imported STL is sewn into a solid when it is closed
Fixed: a sketch projection of an imported edge follows its geometry when the import changes, and a mate on an imported face follows it when the faces are renumbered
Fixed: a damaged geometry file is refused before anything is read from it
Fixed: Fit view frames a part tightly
Fixed: the MCP server works with the current MCP SDK
Fixed: on Wayland, starting on a port already in use no longer crashes, and the app keeps answering remote requests while minimised
Fixed: curves and cam sections are drawn within their tolerance with older OpenCASCADE versions (Ubuntu 24.04)

description.p: Edit faces directly, share sketches between parts, and import more formats.

ul.li: Direct edits: delete, offset, move and replace faces on any body, including imported ones, from the new Direct edit toolbar group. An edit that cannot be built is refused and names the faces it could not handle
Copy a sketch into another part, optionally linked so it follows the original
Import IGES and OBJ, choose the up axis when importing, and bring DXF or SVG drawings into a sketch

Sketching: G2 curvature and arc-length constraints, rescaling a sketch by its first dimension, open-end markers, trimming along a path, and typing name = value into a dimension to make a variable that drives it
Requirements can be written as expressions, and a design sweep checks them across a range of values
Mouse navigation can be set up in Preferences, Navigation, with presets for other CAD programs
Fillet, Chamfer, Shell and the other creation tools size their defaults from the part in front of them
When the graphics device is lost the app rebuilds it and carries on, and when the renderer cannot start it says why
Fixed: large projects stuttered every few seconds, most noticeably on Windows
Fixed: on Windows, a crash inside a system library on a background thread left no crash report, and the newest crash report could be the one cleaned away
Fixed: a fillet or chamfer on a rounded face's edge could pick a different edge after the file was reopened
Fixed: a fillet that could hang, a Shell that could give different results on different runs, and face moves that could take over a minute before giving up
Fixed: files with missing or damaged values are refused with the file and the value named, instead of opening with the value quietly dropped
Fixed: two running copies of the app no longer share one unsaved-work slot
Fixed: the sheet-metal flat pattern exported to DXF now cuts the whole blank
Fixed: placing a fastener, bearing or retaining ring is a single undo step
Fixed: building on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04

description.p: Keep the dimension you just added.

ul.li: Dimensioning something the sketch already fixes names the dimension in the way and offers to use the new one instead, in one undo step
A dimension's right-click menu has Delete

description.p: Windows: the app starts when installed.

ul.li: The window no longer closes at start when the app is installed in its default folder, C:\Program Files\Loböle, or any other path with a non-ASCII character

description.p: The MCP server starts the AppImage by itself.

ul.li: With nothing running, the MCP server now attaches to an app it started through an AppImage or a Flatpak, instead of giving up after a minute

description.p: The full application as an AppImage for most Linux distributions.

ul.li: A GUI AppImage for any distribution with glibc 2.39 or newer: Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 40 and later
Parametric parts: constrained sketches, solid, sheet-metal and tube features, driven by variables and expressions
Assemblies with mates, motion studies and an exploded bill of materials
Drawings exported to SVG and PDF
FEM studies and topology optimisation
CAM: milling toolpaths, simulation and G-code, including a fourth axis
Git-backed history, checkpoints and merges of a diffable project format
A JSON-RPC interface with a Python SDK and an MCP server, the same command layer the GUI uses
